title: Exact abelian pullback composition on single complexes
statement: Let $S,Y,Y\prime$ be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $a:Y\prime\to Y$, $h:Y\to S$, $h\prime:Y\prime\to S$, and $w:a\gg h=h\prime$. Let $A$ be an abelian etale sheaf on $S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $c_f:D^+(f^{-1})(A[0])\to(f^{-1}A)[0]$ for the canonical exact-pullback single-complex comparison [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image]. Let $e:h\prime^{-1}\cong h^{-1}\circ a^{-1}$ be the underived composition comparison and let $\theta:D^+(h\prime^{-1})\cong D^+(h^{-1})\circ D^+(a^{-1})$ be its canonical derived composition comparison, transported along $w$. Then $c_{h\prime}(A)\gg e(A)[0]\gg c_a(h^{-1}A)^{-1}=\theta(A[0])\gg D^+(a^{-1})(c_h(A))$. No shift, direct image, coefficient morphism, raw class, or evaluation occurs in this equality.

No generic coherence lemma is restated.

theorem abelianPullbackSingleComposition {S Y Y' : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h')
    (A : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) :
    (((h')^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app A ≫
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map
          ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a h h' w.symm).hom.app A) ≫
        (((a)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).inv.app _ =
      (eqToIso (congrArg
          (fun t : Y' ⟶ S => ((t)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).mapDerivedCategoryPlus)
          w.symm)).hom.app ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj A) ≫
        (upperStarPlusComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a h).hom.app _ ≫
        D+((a)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map
          ((((h)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app A)
